summary: The proposed GigaBREAD_FixedPol_2026 dark-photon limit faithfully represents the first fixed-polarization DP exclusion from arXiv 2611.07426. All conventions (0.45 GeV/cm3 density per Eq. 3, dimensionless kinetic mixing chi, 44-52 ueV range), the 90% CL (explicitly supported by Eqs. 26/29 and Figs. 3-4), novelty (new combined 2023+2024 fixed-pol analysis, Fig. 6 orange region), numerical values (~8e-13 to 1e-12 matching Figs. 5/6 and the chi~1e-12 headline), and the highlight target all check out.

verdict.summary: The proposed GigaBREAD_FixedPol_2026 dark-photon limit faithfully represents the first fixed-polarization DP exclusion from arXiv 2611.07426. All conventions (0.45 GeV/cm3 density per Eq. 3, dimensionless kinetic mixing chi, 44-52 ueV range), the 90% CL (explicitly supported by Eqs. 26/29 and Figs. 3-4), novelty (new combined 2023+2024 fixed-pol analysis, Fig. 6 orange region), numerical values (~8e-13 to 1e-12 matching Figs. 5/6 and the chi~1e-12 headline), and the highlight target all check out.

result_identity.evidence: Title and abstract (p.1): dark photon kinetic mixing chi exclusion, GigaBREAD. extraction.json coupling_type=DarkPhoton, convention 'kinetic mixing chi'. Correct particle/coupling/paper; exclusion not projection.

novelty.evidence: First fixed-polarization DP search (abstract p.1); Fig. 6 right (p.10) orange 'GigaBREAD: This work' is the new combined 2023+2024 analysis, distinct from blue 'fixed-pol rescaled (previous)'. Text p.9-10 confirms a genuinely new measured bound ~20% stronger than prior rescaling. is_new_limit=true, is_projection=false.

confidence_level.evidence: 90% CL explicitly supported: Eq. 29 Bayesian 90% credible upper limit (p.8), frequentist Monte-Carlo-calibrated 90% CL Neyman construction (p.8), global 90% thresholds in Figs. 3-4 (p.7). Not a default/placeholder. extraction confidence_level=0.9.

conventions.evidence: Density 0.45 GeV/cm3 (Eq. 3, p.3) matches dm_density_assumed=0.45. Kinetic mixing chi dimensionless. Fixed-polarization (polarization-matched likelihood) is the paper's central method (Sec. II-III). Mass 44-52 ueV = 4.4-5.2e-5 eV matches data file. Plot method fill_between uses the final limit curve directly; no physical conversion to bypass.

numerical_agreement.evidence: Traced chi ~8.41e-13 at 48 ueV vs quoted headline chi~1e-12 (abstract). Endpoints: 4.42e-5 eV -> 8.56e-13, 5.16e-5 eV -> 7.19e-13. Fig. 6 right (p.10) orange band bottom sits ~8e-13-1e-12; Fig. 5 fixed-pol curves (2023-only) 0.8-1.1e-12, combined being slightly stronger. Consistent at stated precision.

highlight_target.evidence: DarkPhoton_highlighted.png shows a single narrow dark-red vertical band at ~10^-4.3 eV (44-52 ueV) reaching ~8e-13, matching the data file; no unrelated limit accented. Full view shows the same region with red 'GigaBREAD' label.

visibility.evidence: Relevant mass (44-52 ueV) and coupling (~8e-13) range on-screen in both views; 'GigaBREAD' label present (placed near top per the method's text at dat[0] cap, standard for narrow vertical limits); band interpretable, clearly isolated in highlighted view.
